[EN] We fought side-by-side against Thulsa in Essenia, did we not?

A worthy campaign. Together, we shall sunder his plans and send him back to the Dream!
[ES] Luchamos codo a codo contra Thulsa en Essenia, ¿verdad?

Una campaña digna. ¡Juntos destruiremos sus planes y lo devolveremos al Dream!
